domain_hint: Centrifugal pump CFD for head curve and NPSH assessment
ambiguity_notes:
- Physics/turbulence selection: slides assert SST k–omega with y+≈1, but also state production used realizable k–ε and mixed wall treatments at some points.
- Cavitation handling: plan to use ZGB model; later disabled and NPSHr inferred from single-phase trends, yet sensitivity slide cites a ZGB result from a pilot case.
- Spatial/temporal accuracy: early statements imply second-order schemes throughout; later note first-order upwind used near shutoff and mixed numerics in UQ surrogate.
- Boundary and operating conditions: initial plan mentions mass-flow inlet for test matching; implemented setup uses pressure inlet. NPSH study described as cavitating inlet sweep, but executed as single-phase pressure adjustment.
- Geometry/version control: text references RevD in an earlier note while stating simulations ran on RevC with different wear ring clearance.
- QA/independent review: checklist marked “peer review completed,” but calendar indicates review deferred; comments not dispositioned.
- Mesh adequacy: slide claims y+ 1–2 on blades; another note highlights local y+≈28 at the tongue on the medium grid where pulsation is assessed.
- UQ sampling: plan calls for 500-sample Monte Carlo; executed is 30-sample Latin hypercube with mixed-model training data.
